01222121120020100011110220210 - ASI: 22

Rules:
  00 = 0 * 0
  10 = 1 * 0
  11 = 1 * 1
  12 = 1 * 2
  20 = 2 * 0
  22 = 2 * 2
  012 = 0 * 12
  111 = 1 * 11
  112 = 1 * 12
  210 = 2 * 10
  220 = 2 * 20
  0020 = 00 * 20
  2212 = 22 * 12
  00111 = 00 * 111
  220210 = 220 * 210
  0122212 = 012 * 2212
  1000111 = 10 * 00111
  1120020 = 112 * 0020
  10220210 = 10 * 220210
  01222121120020 = 0122212 * 1120020
  100011110220210 = 1000111 * 10220210
  01222121120020100011110220210 = 01222121120020 * 100011110220210
